cards.title: The Love Hypothesis on Prime Video
cards.text: A highly anticipated rom-com adaptation starring Lili Reinhart and Tom Bateman. We’re settling in for a little academia, a lot of chemistry, and hopefully all the book-to-screen magic.
cards.image_alt: The Love Hypothesis on Prime Video

cards.title: “Nicole Kidman” by Adéla
cards.text: Dreamy, playful, and effortlessly cool, “Nicole Kidman” has been on repeat this week. It’s giving late-night drives, good outfits, and a little main-character energy.

cards.title: Switzy: A Novel by Emma Cline
cards.text: A sharp and darkly funny novel that takes us into the world of celebrity, obsession, and reinvention. A perfect pick for a fall reading list with a little edge.
cards.image_alt: Switzy: A Novel by Emma Cline
